scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.dev:optimizer: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? '.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : '.venv/bin/python'; spawn(py, ['optimizer/app.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n app,optimizer -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev" "npm run dev:optimizer"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build
